content: Bookimen Xoossa Kiitanchcha

GODAA kiitanchchay Gelgelappe Bookime biidi Isra7eele asaas, «Tani inttena Gibxeppe kessada beni intte aawaas immana gaada ta caaqqida biitta inttena gelththadis; histtada ta inttes, ‹Tani inttenara caaqqida caaqo qaalaa mulekka laammike.
Intte ha biittan diza asatara caaqo caaqettofte; istti yarshizasota laallite› gadis; gido attiin intte taas azazettibeekketa; ays hessaththo hanidetii?
Hessa gishshas tani inttena, ‹Istta tani intte sinththafe kessa gooddike; istti inttes morkke gidana; istta eeqa xoossatikka inttes narxa mala gidana› gadis» gides.
GODAA kiitanchchay hessa Isra7eele asaa ubbaas yootida wode asay ba qaalaa dhoqqu histtidi yeekkides.
He sohoza Bookime
giidi sunththides; histtidi he sozan Xoossas yarsho yarshides.
Iyaaso Hayqonne Ooraththa Yeleta
Iyaasoy Isra7eele asaa yeddidaappe guye asay issoy issoy shaakkiin bana gakkiza biitta ekkanaas bides.
Iyaasoy shemppora paxa diza layththa ubbaan asay GODAAS ooththides; izi hayqqidaappe guye GODAY Isra7eele asaas ooththida gita ooso ubbaa be7ida cimata wode ubbaankka GODAAS goynnizayssa aggibeenna.
GODAA aylle Nawe naa Iyaasos layththay 110 gidiin hayqqides;
Ga7aashe dereppe pudeha baggan Efreeme deren bolla gezze biittan Teminaate-Seraaha geetettizason diza iza gaden iza moogida.
He yeleta ubbay hayqqidaappe guye GODAANNE izi Isra7eele asaas ooththida lo7o ooso ubbaa erontta ooraththa yeletay dendides.
Isra7eele Asay Godaas Goynnizayssa Ago
Hessafe guye Isra7eele asay GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides; Ba7aale geetettiza eeqatas goynnides.
Gibxe biittafe istta kessida GODAA, bantta aawata Xoossaa aggaagida; bantta heeran diza asati goynniza eeqatakko simmidi isttas goynnida; hessan GODAA hanqeththida.
GODAAKKA aggidi Ba7aalessinne Astarootes goynnida.

Hessa gishshas GODAA hanqoy Isra7eele asaa bolla eexxi kezides; worajjizayti bonqqana mala istta morkketa kushen aaththi immides; istta heeran diza morkketas istta aaththi immides; hessafe guye istti bantta morkketara eqettanaas dandaybeettenna.
Istti olas keziza wode ubbaan GODAY kase isttas caaqqi yootoyssaththo istti xoonettana mala izi istta bolla dendides; hessafe dendoyssan istti keehi waayettida.
Hessafe guye GODAY Isra7eele asaa bolla worajjizayta kusheppe istta ashshiza daannata isttas denththides;

Gido attiin Isra7eele asay isttas pirdiza daannatas azazettibeenna; istti GODAAS ammanettontta ixxida; eeqa xoossatakko simmidi isttas goynnida; kase bantta aawata ogeppe kare kezida; istta aawati GODAAS azazettida mala istti azazettibeettenna.

GODAY isttas pirdiza daannata daannasida wode ubbaan izi he pirdiza daannatara issife diza gishshas he daannati shemppora paxa diza layth ubbaan istta morkketa kusheppe istta ashshides. Waayeynne tuggay istta bolla darida gaason istti waassizayssa siyidi GODAY isttas qadhettides.

Gido attiin istta kaaleththiza daannati hayqqida wode ubbaan asay guye simmidi, eeqa xoossata kaalon, isttas haggazoninne istta goynon kase istta aawati ooththida iita oosoppe aadhdhida iita ooson simmi gelida; bantta iita oosonne geella oge aggontta ixxida.
Hessa gaason GODAA hanqoy Isra7eele kawoteththaa bolla eexxi kezides; GODAY, «Ha asay tani kase istta aawatara gelida caaqo qaalaa yedhdhi aadhdhida gishshassinne taas azazettontta ixxida gishshas,
hachchife doommiin Iyaasoy hayqqida wode biittaa bollan attida kawoteththatappe issaadeka tani istta sinththafe kessa gooddike.
Ha Isra7eele asay kase bantta aawata mala ta oge kaallizaakkonne kaallonttaako tani istta paaccanaas hayssa ha dereta taas ola massara ooththada isttan go7ettana» gides.
Hessa gishshas GODAY he kawoteththa asay kezontta gam7ana mala ooththides. Izi istta eeson yedeththi kessibeenna; Iyaasoska istta aaththi immibeenna.
